rows.mappingNote: New favorable strong-point/merit article, 特長 とくちょう 1455200:1, separate from existing homophone 特徴.

rows.mappingNote: New specific/designated article, 特定 とくてい 1455210:1; identifying/specifying suru sense2 also taught.

Sixteen new articles and four reused identities. 溶ける receives only a sourced N2 level; とこや retains N4; 飛ぶ and 止まる retain N5. Reused coverage requires actual spelling/reading/use teaching, not only a shared family.
